messages:
sara_dev: Quick sync — final owners & blockers for the v2 compatibility rollout. Proposed high-level timeline: canary next Tue, progressive ramp, full cutover ~3 weeks. I need short ownership callouts: SDK, runtime, platform routing, SRE/runbook, docs, and rollback plan. @olivia_sdk @raj_runtime @kai_platform @eva_sre please reply with one-line status and any hard blockers by EOD :clock3:

olivia_sdk: SDK (JS + Python) owner here. PRs mostly ready, missing platform feature-flag to switch to v2-shim. Will add an integration test for streaming. No blocker except the feature flag. PR: https://git.redwood/rg/sdks/pull/402 :white_check_mark:

raj_runtime: Runtime owner. We've landed the KV-cache alignment for v2 token layout but need to validate quantization fallback path. Planning canary nodes in a dedicated pool. Need ops to provision pool + config toggle: `--v2-compat-mode=true`. Potential blocker: one regression in perf bench on 8k context on A100s — investigating.

michael_pm: PM side — I'll own customer comms and the deprecation timeline. Ask: confirm exact deprecation date we publish (need 2w notice min). Also will own migration doc taskforce (docs + migration snippets).

kai_platform: Platform/routing. I can own route rules and Swagger updates. Depend on eng-infra for canary gating and onload balancer rule for weight split. Also need a mapping table of deprecated endpoints => v2 equivalents.

eva_sre: SRE will run canary smoke and recovery playbooks. Proposed canary policy: 5% traffic for 48h, then 20% for 24h, then 50% for 12h before full cutover. I will author the runbook and rollback steps. Need alert thresholds and quick rollback script from runtime.

anna_reviewer: Code review ping — happy to review SDK PRs and runtime compatibility changes. Please tag me in PRs and add a short "breaking changes" checklist in the PR description. :eyes:

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy window scheduled: 1898770800 — will attempt canary deploy to the dedicated pool. I will post status updates to this thread during deploy.

ci-bot: ci-bot: Heads up — SDK integration test failed on latest CI run (flake in streaming test). Flaky test: `test_stream_close_correctly` in py-sdk. Failing build: https://ci.redwood/build/9002.

security_bot: security_bot: Quick note — audit/logging for v2 must preserve PII redaction parity with v1. If any new headers are introduced, please add redaction rules. Also confirm KMS key versioning for private deployments.

olivia_sdk: Copy — I'll fix the flaky test and add a test matrix with `--v2-compat-mode`. Will add KMS check in SDK integration harness.

raj_runtime: Working on perf regression; initial hypothesis is kernel scheduling difference. If we can't hit perf target by canary, propose gating canary to non-LT* tiers. (cc @kai_platform)

kai_platform: noted. We can do weighted routing by tier, yes. Will create the routing changes and the API mapping doc.

michael_pm: For deprecation publish date — propose 2026-04-20 (3 weeks) unless runtime perf blocker persists. Approve?

sara_dev: Sounds good. Action items recap (one-liners):
- olivia_sdk: own SDK changes + flaky test fix (due EOD tomorrow)
- raj_runtime: perf regression investigation + toggle + rollout scripts (status by EOD)
- kai_platform: routing rules + swagger + mapping table (PR by Tue)
- eva_sre: runbook + canary thresholds + alerts (draft by tomorrow)
- michael_pm: customer comms + deprecation notice (publish if green)
- anna_reviewer: review PRs (please triage)
- security_bot/security: confirm redaction & KMS (confirm by EOD)

Please drop a short ✅ or ⚠️ next to your name once you confirm. If anyone needs help or a formal owner handoff meeting, ping me and we’ll schedule a 15m.

olivia_sdk: ✅

raj_runtime: ⚠️ — investigating perf, will update by EOD

kai_platform: ✅

eva_sre: ✅ (will post runbook link when ready)

michael_pm: ✅

anna_reviewer: ✅ (add me to reviewers on SDK PRs)

security_bot: ✅ (redaction rules ok; KMS plan pending for private deploy — security will reach out)

sara_dev: Thanks all — I'll follow up with a brief owner assignment doc in #eng-platform and ping infra for the feature-flag ticket. :megaphone:
